text: The Aral Sea shrunk primarily due to the diversion of the Amur River for irrigation, which led to the reduction of water flow into the sea. This caused the sea to shrink and eventually dry up. The process was exacerbated by the construction of the Turkestan Canal, which further reduced the water supply.
